implementation:
let rec fold : Expr → Expr
  | .lit n => .lit n
  | .var => .var
  | .add l r =>
    match fold l, fold r with
    | .lit a, .lit b => .lit (a + b)
    | l', r' => .add l' r'
fold e
proof:
by
  unfold Spec
  have invariant : ∀ e env,
      denote env (candidate.fold e) = denote env e := by
    intro e
    induction e with
    | lit n => intro env; rfl
    | var => intro env; rfl
    | add l r ihl ihr =>
      intro env
      change denote env (match candidate.fold l, candidate.fold r with
        | .lit a, .lit b => .lit (a + b)
        | l', r' => .add l' r') = denote env l + denote env r
      have hl := ihl env
      have hr := ihr env
      cases eql : candidate.fold l <;> cases eqr : candidate.fold r <;>
        simp only [eql, eqr, denote] at hl hr ⊢ <;> omega
  constructor
  · intro e env
    simpa only [candidate] using invariant e env
  · intro a b
    rfl
